mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% and remains elevated for two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 declines for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3% combined with a simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary regime, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when CPI > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 1% over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < 1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month over three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS > 150000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential demand and construction sector stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST < 1000000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 declines for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
